policy_date: Last review / last updated 2 January 2024; released to ASX 2 January 2024 as 'updated effective January 2024'
covered_persons: All 'Macquarie Staff', defined to include Staff (employees, agency workers, interns, secondees, contractors/consultants as deemed by RMG Employee Compliance), Key Management Personnel (all Voting Directors and members of the Executive Committee of MGL) and Associates (spouse/partner, dependants under 18, relatives in the same household, and any person whose investment decisions Staff may influence). Additional restrictions apply to KMP and 'Executive Directors' (undefined term) in ss 2.2.3 and 2.4.

trading_windows.closes: Up to five weeks after release, subject to Macquarie's discretion
Up to five weeks after release, subject to Macquarie's discretion
Up to five weeks after the AGM, subject to Macquarie's discretion

trading_windows.opens: Other specific periods where Macquarie has publicly released all relevant price-sensitive information (at Macquarie's discretion)

closed_periods: Not framed as closed periods: all dealing outside a Staff Trading Window is 'strictly prohibited' unless an Excluded Dealing (s 1.3) or an exceptional-circumstances waiver (s 2.3). Windows are 'a conditional exception to the general prohibition on trading, rather than permission to trade'.

derivatives.detail: Derivatives are not separately regulated but are brought inside the definition of 'Macquarie securities', so any dealing in options, warrants, futures or structured products over MQG is subject to the same regime: only during a Staff Trading Window and only with pre-clearance (or by exceptional-circumstances waiver).
derivatives.evidence: Macquarie securities Includes, but is not limited to: ... Structured products providing exposure to MQG shares, including but not limited to ETFs; Futures contracts, options and warrants over MQG shares

hedging_unvested.detail: All Macquarie Staff are prohibited at any time (including inside a window) from entering any transaction designed or intended to hedge exposure to Macquarie securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock or dealing restriction. No approval route is provided.
hedging_unvested.evidence: Macquarie Staff are not permitted at any time to enter into a transaction that is designed or intended to hedge their exposure to Macquarie securities which have not vested or are subject to a holding lock or dealing restriction.

hedging_vested.detail: Hedging of 'unrestricted' Macquarie securities is expressly allowed subject to pre-clearance and the general personal dealing requirements (i.e. inside a Staff Trading Window); for KMP it is additionally subject to the s 2.4 financing-arrangement disclosure regime. Overlay: KMP and Executive Directors may not enter a transaction that limits or reduces the economic risk of their shareholding below the minimum personal shareholding requirement.
hedging_vested.evidence: They can however enter into a transaction intended to hedge unrestricted Macquarie securities subject to pre-clearance and other general personal dealing requirements (and, in respect of Key Management Personnel, subject to section 2.4 below). Key Management Personnel and Executive Directors may not enter into a transaction that operates to limit or reduce the economic risk of their shareholding below the minimum personal shareholding requirement.

monetisation.detail: Forward sales, prepaid variable forwards and equity swaps are not named. They are captured by (a) the broad 'dealing' concept (transfers of beneficial ownership, 'entering into an agreement to trade'), (b) the s 2.2.3 hedging clause where the structure is designed to hedge, and (c) the 'margin loans or other financing arrangements' provisions (ss 2.2.2, 2.4) where the structure is funded. Net effect: allowed over unrestricted securities only, with pre-clearance, in a window, and for KMP subject to s 2.4 disclosure and the minimum-shareholding floor.
monetisation.evidence: Macquarie considers dealing to include, without limitation, securities transactions such as transfers of beneficial ownership and trading (either directly or indirectly), including entering into an agreement to trade.

short_selling.detail: Uncovered short selling of any security including Macquarie securities is prohibited for all Macquarie Staff even when a window is open. Covered short selling is not addressed.
short_selling.evidence: Macquarie Staff are prohibited from engaging in short-term trading and uncovered short selling arrangements in relation to any security, include a Macquarie security (even if the designated Staff Trading Window is open).

margin_lending.detail: Margin loans and other financing arrangements over Macquarie securities are permitted for all Staff with a 'should' obligation to hold sufficient cash or collateral to meet margin calls. For KMP: annual disclosure of financing arrangements to Macquarie, immediate notification to the Company Secretary in the listed circumstances, and pre-clearance (via PTA) before liquidating a position to satisfy a margin call.
margin_lending.evidence: Macquarie Staff who enter into margin loans or other financing arrangements over Macquarie securities should ensure they have sufficient available cash or other acceptable collateral to meet margin calls including during a period of extreme sudden market downturn.

encumbrance.detail: No prohibition on lending, mortgaging or charging Macquarie securities and no requirement that holdings remain unencumbered. KMP must immediately inform the Company Secretary if they hold Macquarie securities that have been lent, mortgaged or charged to a financier, if the financier is or is likely to become entitled to demand payment, or if a demand could not be met without disposing of at least 1% of issued securities.
encumbrance.evidence: KMP must inform the Company Secretary immediately if the following circumstances apply: the member of KMP holds Macquarie securities that have been lent, mortgaged, or charged to a financier

short_term_trading.detail: Short-term trading in any security including Macquarie securities is prohibited for all Macquarie Staff even inside a window. 'Short-term' is not defined.
short_term_trading.evidence: Macquarie Staff are prohibited from engaging in short-term trading and uncovered short selling arrangements in relation to any security, include a Macquarie security (even if the designated Staff Trading Window is open).

approval.approver: Pre-clearance is obtained through Macquarie's conflicts management systems / the PTA personal compliance system (administered by RMG Employee Compliance), plus any additional business group approval; exceptional-circumstances waivers are approved by the ANZ Regional Head of Compliance, Global Head of Compliance or Head of Risk Management Group on written request to RMG Employee Compliance.
approval.validity: All pre-clearances are 'subject to an expiry date' (period not stated) and may be withdrawn if new information comes to light or circumstances change; waivers likewise.
approval.post_trade_notification: None for ordinary dealings. KMP must annually disclose financing arrangements relating to their Macquarie securities and must inform the Company Secretary immediately if securities are lent, mortgaged or charged to a financier (and in the other s 2.4 circumstances).
approval.evidence: Dealing in Macquarie securities by Macquarie Staff must be pre-cleared against Macquarie's conflicts management systems. ... All pre-clearances are subject to an expiry date and may be withdrawn if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances. A denied pre-clearance is final and binding on the Macquarie Staff member who made the request and must be kept confidential.

exceptional_circumstances.detail: A specific waiver to deal outside a Staff Trading Window may be granted for compulsion of law/regulation, severe financial hardship, or other circumstances deemed exceptional. Written request to RMG Employee Compliance with a statutory declaration that the dealing is the only reasonable action available and the person holds no non-public price-sensitive information; approval by the ANZ Regional Head of Compliance, Global Head of Compliance or Head of RMG; absolute discretion, expiry date, refusal final and confidential.
exceptional_circumstances.evidence: A specific waiver from the prohibitions on dealing in a Macquarie security outside a Staff Trading Window may be granted in exceptional circumstances. Exceptional circumstances include where a Macquarie Staff member may need to deal in a Macquarie security: by compulsion of law or regulation ... on account of severe financial hardship.

other_collar_relevant_clauses: s 1.1: 'Macquarie considers dealing to include, without limitation, securities transactions such as transfers of beneficial ownership and trading (either directly or indirectly), including entering into an agreement to trade.' Entering an OTC collar is therefore a 'dealing' and must occur in a Staff Trading Window with pre-clearance.

s 2.1: 'Dealing in a Macquarie security outside a Staff Trading Window by Macquarie Staff is strictly prohibited unless it is an Excluded Dealing (refer to section 1.3 above) or exceptional circumstance (refer to section 2.3 below).' A collar is not an Excluded Dealing.

s 2.2: 'Macquarie Staff may also be subject to additional business group or jurisdictional specific requirements and must consult their business group policy for details.' and the Policy 'should be read in conjunction with the Macquarie Personal Investments Policy' (not provided).

s 2.2.3: hedging of KMP holdings is expressly made 'subject to section 2.4', so a KMP collar is treated as a financing arrangement for disclosure purposes: 'KMP must annually disclose their financing arrangements relating to their Macquarie securities to Macquarie.'
s 2.4: 'Liquidating a position to satisfy a margin call requires pre-clearance against Macquarie's PTA system.' Relevant where a funded collar has a margin/collateral top-up mechanism.

s 2.4: KMP must inform the Company Secretary immediately where 'circumstances have arisen in which the financier is entitled or likely to become entitled to exercise a right under the finance arrangements to demand payment' or where a demand could not be met 'without the disposal of securities representing at least 1% of the total number of issued securities of Macquarie'.

s 3.1 'Associates': the collar restrictions extend to the executive's spouse/partner, dependants, co-resident relatives and any person whose investment decisions the executive may influence (e.g. family trusts/companies).

s 1.1: insider-trading overlay applies 'even if the designated Staff Trading Window is open'; and s 2.2: 'Where pre-clearance is received and business group approval provided, Macquarie Staff must satisfy themselves that the relevant dealing is appropriate and that they do not hold any non-public, price-sensitive information'.
collar_assessment: Yes, in principle. The policy expressly permits transactions 'intended to hedge unrestricted Macquarie securities' subject to pre-clearance (via the PTA/conflicts system, plus any business group approval) and the general dealing rules, so the collar must be entered into during a Staff Trading Window (up to five weeks after interim results, final results or the AGM) and cannot cover any shares that are unvested or subject to a holding lock or dealing restriction (including MEREP RSUs/DSUs/PSUs). For a KMP (Voting Director or Executive Committee member) or an 'Executive Director', the collar must not limit or reduce economic risk on the shareholding below the minimum personal shareholding requirement (set outside this policy), and a KMP must disclose the arrangement annually and notify the Company Secretary immediately if the shares are lent, mortgaged or charged to the bank or the bank becomes entitled to demand payment. Collars, monetisation structures and 'written' clearance are not expressly addressed, and the Personal Investments Policy and business group policies (not provided) may add requirements.
